intent: Reusable overlay surface that renders as dialog, drawer, or sheet depending on `mode`.

behaviours.label: Click Cancel → dialog state → cancelled; title/body switch to 'Edit kept'
Click Discard → dialog state → discarded; title/body switch to 'Changes discarded'
Click Reset → drawer state → reset; body switches to 'Filters cleared.'
Click Apply → drawer state → applied; body switches to 'Filters applied...'
